title: How do I reset a robot's task queue?
body: Use the Falcon admin console, select the robot, and click 'Clear Queue'. This requires operator-level access.

title: What is Orbital Robotics' standard warranty period?
body: All Orbital Robotics hardware ships with a 24-month standard warranty covering manufacturing defects.

title: How do I request a replacement part?
body: Submit a request through the Skyline Parts portal referencing your original invoice number.

title: Who approves parental leave requests?
body: Parental leave requests require approval from both the employee's manager and the Head of HR, Priya Nandakumar.

title: What is the SLA for on-call incident response?
body: The on-call engineer must triage alerts within 15 minutes during business hours per the Falcon on-call policy.

title: How long is annual leave carry-forward allowed?
body: Employees may carry forward up to 10 unused annual leave days into the next calendar year.

title: Which team owns the route-planner service?
body: The route-planner service is owned by the Falcon engineering team, led by Rahul Mehta.

title: What was the outcome of the route-planner migration?
body: The Sprint 14 migration to the new pathfinding algorithm reduced average task completion time by 18%.
